title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where users with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into vulnerability scan data. When another user accesses the Vulnerability Scan Details dashboard and selects these values, Splunk may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the selecting user's permissions. This occurs because the dashboard does not validate destination values before using them in drilldown searches, potentially allowing unauthorized data access and modification.
